hero.title: About Language Zone, German Institute in Dehradun
hero.lead: Language Zone is a German language institute in Dehradun that helps learners reach German proficiency with customised training and certified trainers.

story.title: German training that follows your goal
paragraphs: At Language Zone our focus is exceptional language training that fits the needs of each learner. Our team of certified trainers prepares students, job seekers and professionals for the Goethe-Zertifikat, from the first words at A1 to advanced fluency at C1 and C2.
We teach German together with the culture behind it, so you gain proficiency and the confidence to use the language for study, work and life abroad.
Language Zone is a Brillica Services company.

items.title: Communicative teaching
items.text: You speak German in every session. Grammar is taught in context, then practised in conversation.

items.title: Exam-focused
items.text: Each level follows its Goethe-Zertifikat, with mock tests in the real format.

items.title: Flexible learning
items.text: Online and offline classes, morning and evening batches, and personalised sessions.
